text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff, puff…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Doto. You can take a break over there. I'm going to go for another run.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?! O-Opera O, you still have e-energy?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha! I recognize all of my lovely costars for the outstandingly gifted people they are.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But I cannot expect a leading role to just fall out of the sky and land in my lap.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I must go all in, overcome the fearsome mountain summits, and take the helm.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And that attitude alone proves that I am truly the Overlord!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! And so, I shall begin! The Satsuki Sho isn't far off, you know.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Phew.
Ah! Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Welcome back! Hehe, I heard you went for a jog, so I waited here.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …What for?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I have something to ask you! It's about tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Would you like to go running together?

text_block_list.name: Younger Student A
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Top Road… and Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student B
text_block_list.text: Are they about to run together? I've gotta see this!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student B
text_block_list.text: I've always thought Ayabe is so cool and naturally gifted!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student A
text_block_list.text: But Top Road has been doing amazing lately! Do you know what that means?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: All right. Shall we get started?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Sure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega and Narita Top Road begin their run together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… huff…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Top Road is the first to take the lead. Admire Vega maintains her place behind her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Being particularly skilled at accelerating, Admire Vega normally cuts loose on the final stretch, overcoming her competition. However…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Now!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Top Road makes an early sprint for the finish, and Admire Vega is unable to catch up.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe and Top Road
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I did it… I did it!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …You sure are in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Oh. Hehe… I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: But… I really am happy, honest!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe… I want to beat you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I've come this far all because of that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …What?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I've done my research! Your sudden burst in speed down the homestretch is incredible…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So I thought, how can I keep myself from getting caught off guard? What can I do to win?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ever since, I've been working on my tenacity to make sure my legs never give out, no matter how hard I push.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I really… really wanted to beat you, Ayabe.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I… don't understand.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Why me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Oh, well… umm…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Do you have any plans after this?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Let me get you something to eat as thanks for running with me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hm… I think I'll go with the carrot hamburger steak meal after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: No matter how big the menu is, I always end up ordering what I did last time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …I hear that often.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Opera O is always trying new things when she eats out though, haha!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: What are you going to get?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: A steamed chicken salad.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Okay, a steamed chicken salad and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Wait… only a salad?! You don't have to be so modest!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's fine… Besides, we came here to talk.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Hehe, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So, the reason I'm so fixated on you…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Is because I respect you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Respect?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'm always thinking how important it is to live up to people's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Knowing that there are people that support me and want to see me win makes me happy… and very proud.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: The more I think about how much I want to meet everyone's expectations, sometimes…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I can feel my legs trembling when they cheer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: And then… I sometimes can't achieve what everyone had hoped for.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: But after talking with you and seeing you run in the Hopeful Stakes, I was able to understand.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Even if the pressure gets to me and I'm afraid to let everyone down…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I will make everyone proud, no matter what. As long as I haven't given up, my legs will keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: That's something you taught me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I've made up my mind, Ayabe.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'll win the Triple Crown. That's how I'll live up to everyone's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'll start with the Satsuki Sho…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: And defeat you—the person I respect so much.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (At that moment…)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I felt pierced by her honest eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (My cheeks were tingling.)
Ayabe?
